subject.title: fix(web-fetch): forward NO_PROXY to EnvHttpProxyAgent options so env proxy respects bypass entries

question: Should this branch be narrowed to EnvHttpProxyAgent option hardening, or should it pause behind the canonical NO_PROXY/SSRF policy decision for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93807?
rationale: The code change is not the complete web_fetch fix, and the remaining desired behavior affects operator proxy routing plus the SSRF boundary that automation should not choose.

options.title: Pause For Canonical Policy
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge it until maintainers choose the canonical NO_PROXY behavior for the guarded-fetch path.

options.title: Narrow And Prove Hardening
options.body: Remove the closing claim, add focused option-forwarding coverage, and require redacted live proxy proof before considering this as a small hardening PR.

options.title: Close In Favor Of Canonical Work
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers decide the only acceptable fix belongs in a guarded-fetch replacement PR.

recommendation.title: Pause For Canonical Policy
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge it until maintainers choose the canonical NO_PROXY behavior for the guarded-fetch path.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the clearest history on the trusted env-proxy web_fetch opt-in and guarded-fetch/proxy-env boundary.
